authorOverrides.summary: Digital/mobile canon: legendary and treasure rewards use independent uniform random selection with replacement; rare industries are single-stage buildings with no levels; contracts do not exist and delivery assignments receive no sale bonus; the current online map is the canonical map; Atlantia, Adia and Skull unlock their legendary reward only on first military conquest; expeditions exist only for the seven sea legendary places.
